answer: Miscellaneous >> Islamic Names Question ID: 23036 Country: United Arab Emirates Title: I want to aske one question I kept my son name is Muhammad royem . This is to belong to aoliyallah name he was very close to junaid Baghdadi Rahma tullah . I read in kashaf ul majoob also please can u tell me meaning of this name. I hope u will give response. Question: Dear hazart sahib Aslam u kum I want to aske one question I kept my son name is Muhammad royem . This is to belong to aoliyallah name he was very close to junaid Baghdadi Rahma tullah . I read in kashaf ul majoob also please can u tell me meaning of this name. I hope u will give response thanks Best regards Haroon rashid Answer ID: 23036 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1676/1233/H=1431) We could not get the meaning of Royem in spite of thorough search. However, after consulting different dictionaries, it seems that the word carries good meaning; so, there is no harm if you choose this name for the child. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
